description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 21.06.2021 to 27.06.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification (General) issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new rates of exchange for customs duties and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to customs operations, making it a clear example of Legal/Regulatory matters.
